rows.value: UK Biobank + CARDIoGRAMplusC4D CAD (van der Harst 2018)
rows.quote: GWAS summary statistics for CAD were obtained from a GWAS meta-analysis in CARDIoGRAMplusC4D (including UK Biobank), which involved 122,733 cases and 424,528 controls, primarily of European ancestry [16].
rows.reference_quote: van der Harst P, Verweij N. Identification of 64 novel genetic loci provides an expanded view on the genetic architecture of coronary artery disease. Circ Res. 2018;122(3):433–43.
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the CAD data to reference 16 (DOI of the van der Harst 2018 rows) and describes a meta-analysis of the consortium including UK Biobank, which is the combined row and not the UK Biobank-only row of the same paper; the stated counts equal the sums of that row's two components.

Passages give case and control counts only, with no release number, year, citation or accession; under the standing ruling N alone is unresolved. For the checker: the two counts sum to the total sample size of one release row.

rows.quote: GWAS summary statistics for fasting insulin were obtained from the Meta-Analysis of Glucose and Insulin-related Traits Consortium (MAGIC) [14].
rows.dataset_named_in_source: Meta-Analysis of Glucose and Insulin-related Traits Consortium (MAGIC)
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the consortium as the source of fasting insulin GWAS data; the dictionary has no pqtl-side row for it (its only row for this consortium is on the outcome side).

rows.quote: We used GWAS data from the discovery cohort which were restricted to participants of European ancestry (n = 34,557).
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the discovery cohort, European ancestry, and the exact sample size 34,557, which is that row's and no other candidate's; the same passage describes the project and its Olink panels.

rows.quote: Specifically, we obtained genetic associations with proteins from deCODE genetics, conducted in 35,559 Icelanders [28].
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E, Sulem P, Atlason BA, Sveinbjornsson G, Magnusson MI, Styrmisdottir EL, et al. Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease. Nat Genet. 2021;53(12):1712–21.
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the protein associations to reference 28, whose DOI is that of the Ferkingstad 2021 row only, and gives that row's exact sample size 35,559.
